title: Cascade Ortho Rider Certificate — Retention Phase Within Covered Treatment
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: retention phase and the recognised covered-treatment fee.** Treatment after coverage begins includes the whole retention phase at the end of treatment. In the recognised covered-treatment fee, the part of the fee for retention is therefore kept whole. It is not reduced by the part of the planned treatment months that is covered.

| Appliance on the case | Retention part |
|---|---|
| fixed braces | 10 percent of the fee of the practice now treating the patient |
| clear aligners | 5 percent of that fee |
| limited or interceptive, or any other case | nothing |

The **fee of the practice now treating the patient** is defined as follows:

- for a case that has moved, it is the lesser of the allowed case fee and the rate of the practice named on the latest transfer entry (its treatment fee on that entry divided by the months remaining on it and multiplied by the planned treatment months);
- for any other case, it is the allowed case fee.

*Hypothetical figures:* where the fee of the practice now treating the patient is 4,380.00, the retention part kept whole is 438.00 for fixed braces and 219.00 for clear aligners.
